intro: Hello {{name}}. {{company}} sent you the document above to sign. To see it, we email you a code. The link works until {{date}}.
sessionExpired: 15 minutes have passed since the code. Ask for a new one to go on.
readFirst: Read the document to the end. Your signature goes into your fields in it.
downloadToRead: Download the PDF to read it
consent: I have read the document and sign it electronically. I agree that my electronic signature has the same effect between me and {{company}} as a signature on paper.
privacy: As proof of signing we keep your name and email, IP address, browser and the time of each step. Only {{company}} sees them, with the document.
declined: We told the sender you are not signing.
qesTitle: Do you have a qualified electronic signature?
qesBody: Download the PDF above, sign it with your certificate without changing it and upload it here.

done.body: Done, {{name}}. The document is signed. We emailed it to you with the signing certificate.

closed.title: This link no longer works
closed.declined: You already declined to sign the document.
closed.revoked: The sender cancelled the link. Ask them for a new one.
closed.expired: The link expired. Ask the sender for a new one.
closed.locked: The link locked after too many wrong codes. The sender was told.
